method_naming.reason: The operational safety action is an exact rank-one Euclidean leakage projection applied after local RZF. This is more precise than implying that the incumbent constraint enters only through RZF regularization.

prototype_findings.rate_retention_disposition: The 99.77% rate-retention value is a deterministic local-channel, intra-cell-only software result. It is not evidence of paper-level cellular utility.

scientific_conclusion: The rank-one projection and aggregate budget certificate are sound. The deterministic prototype validates software only; it does not establish dynamic-control value, realistic cellular utility, or standards-aligned performance.
